note: Starland County-run campground in Dry Island Buffalo Jump Provincial Park, on the west side of the Red Deer River at Tolman Bridge on Hwy 585, with large open sites; it cannot be reached from the park's day-use area near Huxley. Cook shelter, hand launch and a boat launch open year-round; no firewood sold. A community gun range is close by. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Oct 7, 2026): 25 large open unserviced sites at C$25, first come first served, exact cash or cheque, cook shelter, vault toilets, potable water. Season approximate -> May 15 - Oct 14. Added potable water. PHONE missing: 403-772-3793. RIVERVIEW: recommend not waterfront (unconfirmed view through a riparian tree belt).
flags: WATERFRONT riverview -> recommend NOT WATERFRONT (unsure = downgrade): 2022 imagery shows the main loop's open sites 100-200 m from the river; only two pads/clearings on the loop's east edge (one with a trailer parked) come within ~35-45 m of the water's edge, and a continuous ~25-m belt of trees and shrubs stands between them and the river, with no open ground. The page says only 'Large, open sites are well suited to RVs' and nothing about river views. The south spur to the boat launch reaches the water but is a launch road, not a camping loop on the tear sheet. A view of the river from the sites could not be confirmed. (Tolman East, across the river, has sites closer to the water - 25-30 m behind a similar belt - and is stored not waterfront.)
